ignoreValues.reason: Deliberate Operate-mode workhorse UI face (not a display/point-of-view face) — DESIGN.md 'One-Face Rule' documents the reasoning; a second display face (Space Grotesk) was explicitly considered and rejected for this exact reason during the redesign
